about_short_description.short_description: Boubyan Bank provides deposits, loans, credit cards, debit cards, prepaid cards, investments, and funds services.

product.name: Deposits
product.description: Deposit accounts for individuals and businesses to hold funds, manage liquidity, and access banking services.

product.name: Loans and Financing
product.description: Financing solutions that provide individuals and businesses with funds for personal needs, purchases, projects, or working capital.

product.name: Credit Cards
product.description: Payment cards that allow customers to make purchases and access credit subject to approved limits and repayment terms.

product.name: Investments
product.description: Investment services that help customers allocate money across eligible investment opportunities according to their financial objectives and risk preferences.

product.name: Debit Cards
product.description: Payment cards linked to customer accounts for purchases, cash withdrawals, and other transactions using available account funds.

product.name: Investment Funds
product.description: Managed pooled investment vehicles that allow customers to invest in a diversified portfolio under defined fund objectives and policies.
